description: Corrective wave for the feat-8 discovery defect. Restores first-hit-wins in DotEnv.discover per ARCH.DOTENV.DISCOVERY and repairs the self-contradictory assertion that caused the inversion. One CU per tree; the files are byte-identical across trees, so the pair is disjoint and runs in parallel. Replaces the six-wave plan, which is preserved in git history at dbc2ccd. Numbered 7, not 1: run-waves writes wave-N-verification.txt and wave-N-commit.txt, so a second run numbered 1 would overwrite the six wave summaries the first run produced. Per-CU feedback is unaffected either way, since those filenames carry the CU id.
